Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SHFWS Tripura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the SHFWS Tripura Recruitment 2026 is 10th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Counsellor & Clinical Psychologist/Psychiatric Social Worker/Psychiatric Nurse posts?
faq.answer: A total of 13 vacancies are available for these posts. 10 vacancies are for Counsellors and 3 vacancies are for Clinical Psychologists/Psychiatric Social Worker/Psychiatric Nurse.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: For the Counsellor post, candidates need a Masters in Clinical Psychology / Social Work or a related discipline, or a Bachelor in Psychology or Social Work with 2 years of experience in Mental Health Work.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 40 years. However, age relaxation is provided for SC/ST candidates up to 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for SHFWS Tripura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Clinical Psychologist/Psychiatric Social Worker/Psychiatric Nurse post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Clinical Psychologist/Psychiatric Social Worker/Psychiatric Nurse post is Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an Academic Performance Index (API) of 90 marks and a Viva-voce of 10 marks, followed by the creation of a Merit List.

faq.question: Q8. In which mode can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply for this recruitment through the offline mode only. The application form needs to be downloaded, filled, and sent via post.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of State Health & Family Welfare Society Tripura, which is http://tripuranrhm.gov.in/job.html.

faq.question: Q10. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the SHFWS Tripura Recruitment 2026 is scheduled to be held on 18th September 2026.
